1. Kulāvakajātaka Nests: a past life story

“Kulāvakā mātali simbalismiṁ, Mātali, don’t ram the bird nests Īsāmukhena parivajjayassu; in the red silk-cotton woods with your draft-pole. Kāmaṁ cajāma asuresu pāṇaṁ, I’d rather give up our lives to the titans Māme dijā vikkulāvā ahesun”ti. than deprive these birds of their nests.

Kulāvakajātakaṁ paṭhamaṁ.
